text:
rachel: Quick check — can someone pull a vendor allocation snapshot for the next 72h? We're merging a big sweep this Friday and finance wants invoice alignment. thinking A100/H100 mix; need headroom for Dedicated burst.

ben: yep, on it. pulling vendor portal now. will post numbers in a sec :eyes:

sre-bot: ALERT: new quota change detected for vendor 'SkyRack'. delta: +12 slots but region us-west1 showing pending. See https://vendor.portal/alloc/2345

ben: snapshot: total alloc across vendors for 72h: A100: 84 slots, H100: 28 slots, Ephemeral spots: 120. us-west1: A100 avail=12 (pending invoice hold), h100 avail=2. raw CSV attached in thread.

rachel: thanks. can you paste the cli command you used? want to add to runbook.

ben: command i used:
``
vendorctl --vendor skyrack export-alloc --window 72h --format csv > skyrack-alloc.csv
``
also checked terraform state for dedicated pools:
``
terraform state show module.dedicated_pool.aws_instance_group.pool-a100
``

marta: finance flagged invoice #12345 as unpaid — that's the pending hold on us-west1. @finance-bot any update?

finance-bot: Invoice #12345 status: pending-approval. Requested additional PO details from procurement@vendor on 2026-03-20. ETA response: 48h.

alex: pushed PR that unblocks the merge if we can reserve a soft-hold. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 — adds soft-reserve flag to allocator (cc @sam)

sam: lgtm, small nits fixed. if finance can't clear invoice, fallback plan: shift 20% of H100 load to eu-west1 overnight and scale batch windows. I can schedule the reroute at 02:00 UTC.

rachel: sounds good. action items: (1) ben follow up vendor for invoice docs, (2) finance-bot escalate PO, (3) sam prep reroute playbook, (4) alex can merge PR after CI. ping here when done. :white_check_mark:
